column1: # Russian glossary. Claude-only proposal, drafted 2026-11-05 alone by Claude, pending the three-vendor debate; not final. No native speaker has reviewed it.
# Same columns as en.tsv: term holds the Russian, forms separated by " | ". Definitions are D3's where D3 changed them (scratch/english-fixes/d3-glossary.tsv, approved, not merged).
# Every source starts with claude-only and the model id, as l10n/README.md asks, so draft openai|google refuses this file until the council has judged it.

# Rows D3 retires stay, mapped to the chosen term, until D3 merges and en.tsv drops them. D3's new and renamed rows wait in l10n/pending/glossary-d3/ru.tsv, because the loader refuses an id en.tsv lacks.
# acceleration-eco and acceleration-turbo become dnt=yes in D3; drop these two rows when D3 merges.
# Matching: a form ending in a vowel inflects only with a stem of five letters or more, so consonant-final and short forms are listed.
# PIN stays Latin and alone: check.py refuses a Latin-Cyrillic hyphen word (PIN-код), and strings mark PIN do-not-translate.

# HOLD until D3 merges: en.tsv and the strings still use Top speed and Maximum speed in their old senses, while the top-speed and maximum-speed rows below already use D3's. Following those rows now would call the setting Пиковая скорость and the measured value Максимальная скорость, the swap section 7 of the style guide forbids.

# So do not draft or merge these keys before D3: dashboard_model_tile_top_speed, controls_experimental_speed_limit, the readings_maximum_speed_kmh ladder (with _short and _compact), and main_speed_* if they arrive first. They stay English (council verdict fallback). pack.py has no per-key filter, so a run over those areas must rule them out by hand.
# NOT held, translate now: rides_tile_max_speed (English Max speed, D3 Top speed) is the measured value, so it is Пиковая скорость, short Пик скорости, never Макс. скорость.

# NOT held, translate now, and expect a glossary warning until D3: compat_question_units_mph, compat_question_units_kmh, compat_question_range use дисплей самоката; dashboard_model_qa_dashboard_sound, its _short and main_group_dashboard_sound use Дисплей и звук. Their English says dashboard for the scooter's own screen, and the dashboard row means Volt's Home, so following that row would point the rider at the wrong screen.
